limitations: No state-of-the-art claim. Public-core contains fit-query overlap; fit-disjoint applicability is limited to the checkout reference ledger.
The baseline public gate fails reproducibly for CoSQA forced-neural: nDCG@10 0.13750747938486976 < 0.14; recall@20 0.34 < 0.35. Thresholds are unchanged.
The 600-query challenge aborts on an unquoted SQL/code prompt containing AND. Closed code fences work in a focused reproduction; automatic plain-text interpretation is not implemented.
Broad Criterion, relevance, and enrichment pilots overlapped other work. Paired final scoring and SSD trials were run separately from other heavy local jobs.
Million-chunk query quality is synthetic needle retrieval, not general code relevance. First-results timing is not full semantic readiness.
Million-chunk CLI warm and concurrent queries reuse earlier RPC requests and are result-cache eligible. Cached neural provenance is not proof of repeated model execution.
Windows historical-only context remains unavailable without safe subprocess anchoring; deletion metadata and live-file context remain supported.
GPU inference, musl containers, and x86 emulation were not executed on this ARM64 host.
